fact: As of May 2026 the SIGFU web portal and mobile app let users follow land files lodged at the Guichet Unique du Foncier online (ACD, ADU, permits), submit supporting documents electronically and file claims, and a land status/history request is partly dematerialised on the public service portal.
title: Démarches foncières en ligne : découvrez les nouveaux services disponibles en Côte d’Ivoire
